label: UniFi Cloud Gateway Industrial
description: UniFi Cloud Gateway Industrial (UCG-Industrial) - 4x 2.5G RJ45 (2 PoE+++ / 2 PoE+) + 1x 10G RJ45 (PoE+++) + 1x 10G SFP+ (10G/1G). WiFi 6/7; 28 W max.

poe.note: The budget is a function of the power input, and the vendor states both numbers in one row: "PoE Budget = DC input: 270W / ATX power: 75W" (Hardware section, read 2026-11-19: https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/cloud-gateways/ucg-industrial). 270 W is recorded because it is the ceiling, the same convention as devices/allied-telesis/at-x530dp-28ghxm.json; the same chassis on ATX power has 75 W. The five PSE ports are the vendor's own census - "2.5 GbE RJ45 = 4 (2 PoE+++, 2 PoE+)", "10 GbE RJ45 = 1 (PoE+++)" - with per-port maxima "PoE+ = 30W", "PoE+++ = 90W", "Voltage Range PoE Mode = 50-57V". 3 x 90 W + 2 x 30 W is 330 W, so the budget is what stops a full-power fill; it is not a sum of the ports.
